name: lchase
description: Lawrence Chase's engineering skills for agentic development workflows.

plugins.name: smart-review
plugins.description: Multi-lens code review of a diff: six specialized lenses (spec-conformance, correctness, security, performance, design, tests) merged into one deduplicated, severity-ranked verdict. Fast single-pass (min) and orchestrated ensemble (max) modes.

plugins.name: tldraw
plugins.description: Turn a natural-language description of a flowchart, architecture diagram, process map, or state machine into an editable tldraw document (.tldr) plus a rendered PNG/SVG. Provides the /tldraw:diagram skill.

plugins.name: test-drive
plugins.description: Record a before/after test drive of a UI or backend API change: /test-drive:baseline records the app before you edit, /test-drive:compare replays the same scripted scenario after the change and gives a deterministic pass/warn/fail verdict, with a side-by-side video for UI or a request, response, and server-log report for API.

plugins.name: cache-clock
plugins.description: Claude Code mod: a band line showing whether the prompt cache is still warm, with countdown, reuse percentage, cached tokens, and estimated cold-rewrite cost, plus a Compact button and /cache-clock command.

plugins.name: usage-gauge
plugins.description: Claude Code mod: a band line showing plan usage windows (5-hour, weekly, spend limit) with reset times, pace warning, session cost on API billing, threshold toasts, and a /usage-gauge command with a detail pane.

plugins.name: auto-handoff
plugins.description: Claude Code mod: a band line showing how full the chat is, saving a HANDOFF.md at a threshold (auto or on request), then clear and continue or resume in a new session, plus a /auto-handoff command.
